 News › News News › CBSE LOC 2027: Late fee rules after correction window; Check important guidelines CBSE LOC 2027: Late fee rules after correction window; Check important guidelines
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 4, 2026, 10:09 IST CBSE LOC Correction Window CBSE LOC 2027: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has opened List of Candidates (LOC) correction window 2026-27 for students appearing for Class 10 and 12 board exams. According to the notification, affiliated schools must verify information submitted for their students and correct any errors before the last date.
 CBSE LOC correction facility allows schools to rectify discrepancies in students' personal and academic details. Students and parents should contact their respective school authorities if they find any mistakes in the submitted information.
 CBSE LOC 2027: Late fee after regular deadline 
 CBSE provided schools with a separate late-submission facility for completing the LOC process. Schools submitting candidate details during late-fee period were required to pay an additional fee of INR 2,000 per candidate, over and above applicable exam fee.
 However, late-submission period should not be confused with CBSE LOC correction window. The late fee was applicable to delayed submission of candidate details, while correction window is meant for rectifying eligible errors in the information already-submitted. So, schools should not assume that payment of late fee will automatically permit changes after correction window closes.
 CBSE LOC 2027: What details can be corrected? 
 CBSE LOC correction facility is intended to address errors in candidate information submitted for board exams 2027. Schools should carefully verify these details
 Student's name: Ensure that full name is entered correctly without abbreviations.
 Parents' names: Verify spelling of father's, mother's or guardian's name.
 Date of birth: Check that date matches the student's official records.
 Subject choices: Confirm that subjects selected for board examinations are correct.
 Surname and passport details: Ensure that surname is included and that details match passport, wherever applicable.
 CBSE LOC 2027: What after correction window closes? 
 Once correction facility closes, schools will have to follow the board's instructions regarding submitted CBSE LOC data. 
 They should ensure that all eligible corrections are completed before deadline. Students should contact their respective school authorities to verify their names, parents' names, date of birth, subject combinations and other examination-related information.
 Students and parents should contact their respective school officials to check details submitted in CBSE LOC form. Since correction facility is available to school authorities, students cannot independently edit their information through the CBSE portal.
 Schools should complete the verification process within the permitted period and ensure that all candidate details are accurate. Any discrepancy should be reported immediately to the school administration.
 CBSE Date Sheet 2027 
 The Board is expected to release the CBSE date sheet 2027 Class 10, 12 in the last week of November 2026 on the official website. The Class 10, 12 board exams CBSE Board will be conducted between February 15 and April first week in pen and paper format.
